questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: Hospitals preparing for new Medicaid work rules and funding cuts
Democrats' plan to repeal the Trump tax cut package
Arkansas's 2018 experiment with Medicaid work mandates
Rural hospitals closing because of nursing shortages
questions.explain: Hospitals are mobilizing outreach so patients keep coverage under work rules starting in January.

questions.q: How many hours a month must affected adults work, volunteer, or study?
questions.explain: The rules require at least 80 hours a month.

questions.q: After Nebraska imposed work rules in May, wait times at its Medicaid call center rose to as much as how long?
questions.explain: Wait times rose to as much as two hours from under 30 minutes.

questions.q: What share of the Arkansas people who lost insurance had actually met the requirement or should have been exempt?
questions.explain: A New England Journal of Medicine survey found 92 percent of those who lost insurance met the rule or should have been exempt.

questions.q: Why is a rollback of the Medicaid cuts uncertain even with the Democratic majority?
options: Democrats lack votes to override a presidential veto
Federal courts have already upheld the new work rules
Hospital groups oppose repealing the Medicaid cuts
Most states control the Medicaid funding formula
questions.explain: Democrats cannot override a veto unless they strike a deal with Republicans.
